approval.basis: User explicitly requested breakdown and GitHub upload of remaining female day running editorials.

copy.captionKo: 포레스트 그린 위로, 차콜과 블랙의 리듬.
copy.captionEn: Forest green, grounded in charcoal and black.
copy.captionDe: Waldgrün, geerdet durch Anthrazit und Schwarz.
copy.introKo: 딥 그린 셸을 열어 차콜 하프집의 짧은 지퍼 라인을 보여줘요. 블랙 타이츠와 글러브로 실루엣을 정리하고 그레이 러너로 밝기를 조금 더해요.
copy.introEn: Open the deep green shell to reveal the charcoal half-zip. Black tights and gloves keep the silhouette controlled, while grey runners add a lighter finish.
copy.introDe: Öffne die tiefgrüne Jacke, damit der kurze Reißverschluss des anthrazitfarbenen Shirts sichtbar wird. Schwarze Tights und Handschuhe halten den Look klar; graue Laufschuhe hellen ihn auf.

products.descriptionKo: 포레스트 그린 셸을 열어 차콜 이너를 보여줘요. 반사 라인은 색을 더하지 않는 작은 디테일이에요.
products.descriptionEn: Open the forest shell to show charcoal beneath; silver lines add detail without another colour.
products.descriptionDe: Öffne die waldgrüne Jacke über Anthrazit; silberne Linien ergänzen Details ohne eine weitere Farbe.
products.altKo: 포레스트 러닝 셸 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: forest green hooded lightweight zip running windbreaker, elastic cuffs, thin silver reflective accents at shoulders, upper sleeves and lower front pockets

products.descriptionKo: 하프집의 스탠드 칼라를 셸 안쪽에 정리해요. 짧은 검은 지퍼가 중심선을 만들어요.
products.descriptionEn: Set the half-zip collar neatly inside the shell and use its short black zip as a central line.
products.descriptionDe: Ordne den Stehkragen innerhalb der Jacke; der kurze schwarze Reißverschluss bildet die Mittellinie.
products.altKo: 차콜 하프집 롱슬리브 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: heather charcoal close-fitting long sleeve technical running top, stand collar and black quarter/half zipper at front; hidden sleeves conservatively reconstructed

products.descriptionKo: 블랙 타이츠로 딥 그린과 차콜을 간결하게 받쳐요. 무릎과 밑단의 원단을 매끈하게 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Ground green and charcoal with black tights, smoothing the fabric at knees and hems.
products.descriptionDe: Erde Grün und Anthrazit mit schwarzen Tights und streiche den Stoff an Knien und Säumen glatt.
products.altKo: 블랙 러닝 타이츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: full-length fitted black running tights with small silver lower-leg reflective strips, waistband and lower section partly concealed, conservative reconstruction

products.descriptionKo: 차콜 글러브를 이너와 맞춰요. 커프를 셸 소매 안쪽에 넣어 손목선을 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Match charcoal gloves to the inner layer and tuck their cuffs inside the shell sleeves.
products.descriptionDe: Stimme anthrazitfarbene Handschuhe auf die innere Lage ab und stecke ihre Bündchen unter die Jackenärmel.
products.altKo: 차콜 러닝 글러브 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair charcoal black full-finger running gloves, long simple cuff and thin silver reflective hand-back stripe, match reference

products.descriptionKo: 밝은 그레이 러너로 어두운 착장 아래에 가벼운 면을 만들어요. 실버 패널과 셸의 작은 라인을 연결해요.
products.descriptionEn: Light grey runners lift the dark outfit and echo the small silver lines on the shell.
products.descriptionDe: Hellgraue Laufschuhe lockern den dunklen Look auf und greifen die silbernen Linien der Jacke auf.
products.altKo: 그레이 메쉬 러너 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair grey mesh lace-up running shoes with silver grey overlays and thick off-white soles; reference shows mainly one shoe, conservatively mirror its design

reconstructionNotes: Hidden backs, waistbands, inside construction and opposite shoes are conservative reconstructions, not verified product specifications.
